CorrectiveAction.description: Adjust the pause plunger so stop discs do not activate from slight touch or vibration.
CorrectiveAction.instruction_text: Tighten the plunger to increase activation pressure and loosen to decrease activation pressure.
CorrectiveAction.name: Adjust pause plunger activation pressure

CorrectiveAction.description: Run the touch screen calibration procedure and save the calibration.
CorrectiveAction.instruction_text: Power down the cutting system, enter the Calibration Screen, press Touch screen, press the calibration cross targets, then select save and exit.
CorrectiveAction.name: Calibrate touch screen

CorrectiveAction.description: Restore the focusing lens condition by cleaning or replacing it.
CorrectiveAction.instruction_text: Clean or replace lens as required.
CorrectiveAction.name: Clean or replace focusing lens

CorrectiveAction.description: Remove debris from or replace the laser nozzle.
CorrectiveAction.instruction_text: Clean or replace laser nozzle as required.
CorrectiveAction.name: Clean or replace laser nozzle

CorrectiveAction.description: Restore the beam-deflecting mirrors by cleaning or replacing them.
CorrectiveAction.instruction_text: Clean or replace mirrors as required.
CorrectiveAction.name: Clean or replace beam-deflecting mirrors

CorrectiveAction.description: Ground the AC supply near the transformer feeding the cutting system.
CorrectiveAction.instruction_text: Install an earth ground as close as possible to the transformer feeding AC power to the cutting system.
CorrectiveAction.name: Install earth ground

CorrectiveAction.description: Install filters when RF interference remains an issue.
CorrectiveAction.instruction_text: If RF is still determined an issue, installation of RF filters and/or power line filters may be required.
CorrectiveAction.name: Install RF or power line filters

CorrectiveAction.description: Assign the tool to the spindle or assign the layer to the tool before cutting.
CorrectiveAction.instruction_text: Click and drag the tool to the spindle or the layer to the tool before sending the file to the cutter.
CorrectiveAction.name: Map tool and layer

CorrectiveAction.description: Open the cutting software on the cutting system computer.
CorrectiveAction.instruction_text: Make sure your cutting software is open on the cutting system computer.
CorrectiveAction.name: Open cutting software

CorrectiveAction.description: Replace the brass laser nozzle when damage is present.
CorrectiveAction.instruction_text: Replace nozzle if any damage is present.
CorrectiveAction.name: Replace damaged laser nozzle

CorrectiveAction.description: Touch the screen to exit sleep mode.
CorrectiveAction.instruction_text: Touch the screen to see if it turns on.
CorrectiveAction.name: Wake the touch screen

FailureMode.description: A beam-deflecting mirror is dirty, damaged, or has a burn mark.
FailureMode.name: Beam-deflecting mirror dirty or damaged

FailureMode.description: The cutting software is not open on the cutting system computer.
FailureMode.name: Cutting software closed

FailureMode.description: The focusing lens is dirty or damaged, reducing laser cutting power.
FailureMode.name: Focusing lens dirty or damaged

FailureMode.description: The brass laser nozzle is damaged, producing an excessively wide laser path.
FailureMode.name: Laser nozzle damaged

FailureMode.description: The laser nozzle contains dirt or debris that reduces cutting power.
FailureMode.name: Laser nozzle dirty or obstructed by debris

FailureMode.description: A bent tube or nozzle causes the laser beam to reflect from the nozzle wall.
FailureMode.name: Laser nozzle or tube bent

FailureMode.description: The stop-disc pause circuit activates intermittently from slight touch or vibration.
FailureMode.name: Intermittent pause circuit at stop discs

FailureMode.description: The Ethernet power supply has no illuminated power-status LED.
FailureMode.name: PoE power supply unpowered

FailureMode.description: Radio-frequency or electromagnetic interference generates electrical noise in the computer controls.
FailureMode.name: RF/EMI electrical noise affecting computer controls

FailureMode.description: A layer is not mapped to a tool or the tool is not assigned to the tool holder.
FailureMode.name: Tool and layer mapping not assigned

FailureMode.description: The touch screen coordinate calibration does not match the displayed button locations.
FailureMode.name: Touch screen out of calibration

FailureMode.description: The touch screen is in its protective sleep mode after prolonged inactivity.
FailureMode.name: Touch screen in sleep mode

Symptom.description: The tool or pen does not move down or is delayed at the beginning of a cut.
Symptom.name: Cutting tool or pen does not move down

Symptom.description: The laser cutting path increases to an undesirable width.
Symptom.name: Laser cutting path is too wide

Symptom.description: Odor is present during laser cutting or the laser cutting path is wider than normal.
Symptom.name: Laser fume extractor has reduced or no vacuum

Symptom.description: Laser cutting power decreases and produces non-cut edges.
Symptom.name: Loss of laser cutting power

Symptom.description: RF or EMI generates electrical noise and causes problems for the machine and computer.
Symptom.name: Machine or computer problems from RF/EMI

Symptom.description: The machine stops in the middle of a cut and displays a machine-paused message.
Symptom.name: Machine pauses during cutting

Symptom.description: The screen must be touched above, below, right, or left of the displayed button.
Symptom.name: Touch screen buttons are out of alignment

Symptom.description: The UIT screen is blank and not lit up.
Symptom.name: UIT does not power up
